preamble: The Middle Chinese 初 (chū) initial, an aspirated postalveolar affricate [tʃʰ] (Baxter tsrh-, Zhengzhang /t͡ʃʰ/) of the 莊 group, merged into the aspirated retroflex affricate [ʈʂʰ] in Mandarin, together with the aspirated initials of the 知 and 章 groups.
